items.description: One intentional adjacency between two authority-owned regions. It is topology, not visible furniture: no placement, screen, or portal is required. The compiler derives the overlap needed for observation, interaction, grounding, and handoff from the two delivered documents.

name.description: This document's stable name for the edge.

destination.description: A global persisted destination naming the neighbouring authority.

counterpart.description: The reciprocal adjacency row in the destination document.

center.description: The boundary rectangle's center in this world's coordinates.

width.description: The full span along the boundary's local right axis.

height.description: The full span along the boundary's local up axis.

onUnavailable.description: Optional declared channel pressed once on the body after the engine applies the failure treatment. Use a kit action on this channel for authored sound, animation, state, or other feedback; ownership safety never depends on the binding.

capacity.description: The maximum number of live bodies and outstanding reservations admitted through this border at once, or null to use the destination population's remaining capacity — the same policy Capacity gives portal furniture. A full border refuses the current attempt immediately; it never queues.
